{{Quote|That Yansan operates in an area of heavy Rebel activity lends to this high percentage, but regardless of whether he intentionally chooses Alliance craft is irrelevant: he is costing the Alliance money, time and equipment, and is threatening many operations in Hijoian Space.|Rebel Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex file on Yansan|<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
'''Hijoian Space''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It contained the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Ichalin Station]] as well as the [[Hijoian system]], which was the site of both the celestial body [[Hijo]] and the [[Hijoian Docks]]. By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Yansan]] operated in Hijoian Space, with Yansan's activities in the sector posing a significant threat to the Alliance. Hijoian Space was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[12 ABY/Legends|ten years]] later.

==Description==
Hijoian Space was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Vardoss sector/Legends|Vardoss sector]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], the Expansion Region's [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] [[spinward]], and the [[Neshei sector/Legends|Neshei]] and [[Sarla sector/Legends|Sarla sectors]] in the [[trailing]] direction. The sector also formed a part of the Expansion Region's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] border with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref> Hijoian Space retained those borders [[12 ABY/Legends|twelve years]] later.<ref name="EGTW" /> The sector included the [[Hijoian system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which contained both the astronomical object [[Hijo]]<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> and the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as the [[Hijoian Docks]]<ref name="CSWE Hijoian">{{CSWECite|II|42|Hijoian Docks}}</ref> as well as [[Ichalin Station system/Legends|another star system]] that contained [[Ichalin Station]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:YansanCloseup.png|thumb|right|200px|The terrorist Yansan operated in Hijoian Space.]]
By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2 ABY">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Hijoian Space was the site of heavy [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] activity. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Yansan]] also operated in the sector, frequently [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaging]] Alliance [[Starship/Legends|starships]] there, including at Ichalin Station and the Hijoian Docks.<ref name="AIR" />

The Rebel [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] eventually compiled a [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on Yansan, in which it was noted that the Ho'Din was threatening many Alliance operations in Hijoian Space. The datafile also judged Yansan to be a high-level threat both in that sector and its nearby [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] areas.<ref name="AIR" /> Hijoian Space fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by 12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hijoian Space was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> Hijoian Space was provided a visual depiction on a map by [[Modi]] included in<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[April 3]], [[2012]]<ref name="Penguin-Paperback">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/180097/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-star-wars-by-jason-fry-with-paul-r-urquhart/9780345477620|text=The Essential Guide to Warfare: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="EGTW" /> On [[October 26]] of the same year, the sector was depicted on a map published in "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," a feature of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to<ref name="Expansion" /> the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> which placed it in grid square J-8.<ref name="Expansion" />

The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' placed both the Hijoian Docks<ref name="CSWE Hijoian" /> and Ichalin Station in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]].<ref name="CSWE Ichalin">{{CSWECite|II|76|Ichalin Station}}</ref> ''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion, however, overrode the information from the former book by placing the corresponding [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] of the Hijoian Docks and Ichalin Station in Hijoian Space while the Fakir sector was placed in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" />
